craft_notes: Sthāyin: Rati for sight and stay (abhilāṣa) settling into praise. Em-dash pause moved to line end (vow held, staying released). Rejected: 'alone!' cry — plain close kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Life-long, world-Lord, be this our charge, by grace of thee —
to bide with mind one-pointed upon thee alone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yāvajjīvaṃ jagannātha kartavyam idam astu naḥ tvatprasādāt tvadekāgramanaskatvena yā sthitiḥ
